matrix_label: M5 symbol-linked reference-card primitive: initiating code anchor, symbol anchor, linkage strength, source provider, version scope, cited revision, and freshness posture

reference_card_rows.scope_summary: The editor hover/peek reference card keeps the initiating file/symbol anchor visible so an exact live function match reads as exact-symbol linkage, a nearby vendor type reads as nearby-version linkage, and an unresolved anchor served from a mirror reads as a keyword fallback — never an exact symbol match

linkage_disclosure.headline: This card appeared because the symbol resolved to an exact match at this version — [exact-symbol] exact_symbol_linkage linkage on a function_symbol anchor in exact_version_match scope (source: first_party_hosted, override: no_override)

This card appeared because the symbol resolved only against a nearby version — [nearby-version] nearby_version_linkage linkage on a type_symbol anchor in nearby_version scope (source: third_party_hosted, override: no_override)

This card appeared because no symbol resolved and the card was matched by keyword — [keyword-only] keyword_fallback_linkage linkage on a unresolved_anchor anchor in latest_stable scope (source: mirrored_registry, override: no_override)

reference_card_rows.scope_summary: The docs-browser reference card renders the shared primitive so a project-specific codebase symbol reads as project-specific linkage, a mirror-served type reads as heuristic linkage that is mirrored-explicit-not-live, and an exact live module match reads as exact-symbol linkage — the same anchor/linkage vocabulary the editor shows

linkage_disclosure.headline: This card appeared because a project-specific doc took precedence for this symbol — [project-doc] project_specific_linkage linkage on a function_symbol anchor in project_specific scope (source: first_party_hosted, override: project_pinned_override)

This card appeared because the symbol resolved only heuristically from a mirror or cache — [heuristic] heuristic_linkage linkage on a type_symbol anchor in pinned_range scope (source: mirrored_registry, override: no_override)

This card appeared because the symbol resolved to an exact match at this version — [exact-symbol] exact_symbol_linkage linkage on a module_symbol anchor in latest_stable scope (source: first_party_hosted, override: no_override)

reference_card_rows.scope_summary: The AI-explanation reference card renders the shared primitive so an AI-derived field/method reads as nearby-version linkage with an unknown-freshness posture, an unresolved stale anchor reads as unresolved-no-linkage flagged stale, and an exact local macro reads as exact-symbol linkage — never an AI paraphrase that hides how weak the linkage is

linkage_disclosure.headline: This card appeared because the symbol resolved only against a nearby version — [nearby-version] nearby_version_linkage linkage on a field_or_method anchor in unversioned scope (source: ai_derived, override: explicit_user_preference)

This card appeared because the anchor is unresolved and no symbol linkage exists — [no-linkage] unresolved_no_linkage linkage on a unresolved_anchor anchor in pinned_range scope (source: offline_import, override: vendor_source_unavailable)

This card appeared because the symbol resolved to an exact match at this version — [exact-symbol] exact_symbol_linkage linkage on a macro_symbol anchor in exact_version_match scope (source: bundled_local, override: local_freshness_override)

reference_card_rows.scope_summary: The onboarding reference card renders the shared primitive so an exact live first-party function reads as exact-symbol linkage, while a cached community plugin type reads as heuristic linkage that is cached-explicit-not-live — the same anchor/linkage/freshness vocabulary a docs-browser reader sees

linkage_disclosure.headline: This card appeared because the symbol resolved to an exact match at this version — [exact-symbol] exact_symbol_linkage linkage on a function_symbol anchor in unversioned scope (source: first_party_hosted, override: no_override)

This card appeared because the symbol resolved only heuristically from a mirror or cache — [heuristic] heuristic_linkage linkage on a type_symbol anchor in pinned_range scope (source: offline_import, override: explicit_user_preference)

reference_card_rows.scope_summary: The support evidence reference card renders the shared primitive so an exact release-notes field decided by policy reads as exact-symbol linkage with a recently-synced posture, while a stale vendor type whose upstream was unavailable reads as heuristic linkage flagged stale — both keep the initiating anchor and source descriptors so identity survives the support/AI evidence path
